sentences.text:
?Court No. - 84
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6371 of 2023

Applicant :- Mahan Mudgal
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Today Sri Ajay Kumar Panday, Advocate filed his power on behalf of informant, which is taken on record.
Heard Sri Vijay Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ajay Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Suresh Bahadur Singh, learned A.G.A. Ist for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 626 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station- Shahganj, District- Agra during pendency of the trial in the court below.

The first information report of the present case was lodged against applicant and others and as per allegations, applicant on the basis of forged educational documents registered himself as an advocate and he is an active member of a gang, who indulged in preparing forged certificates.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and applicant is a respected advocate of District- Agra and he never on Mahan Mudgal vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65488664/
1 the basis of forged educational documents became advocate.

sentences.text:
He further submitted that in fact in the year 2006, applicant appeared in Class-X Examination of U.P. Board and he passed with third division and his subject was arts but from his performance, his parents were not satisfied and therefore, under their pressure applicant again appeared in the examination of Class-X conducted by U.P. Board in the year 2008 but this time he could not succeed and failed and thereafter,
applicant used his third division mark-sheet of the year 2006 and completed his further education and he neither prepared any fake mark-sheet nor on the basis of any fake mark-sheet, completed his further education.
He further submitted that he never registered himself as an advocate on the basis of fake documents.

He further submitted that husband of the informant committed murder of father of applicant and in this regard applicant filed an first information report on 03.11.2021 against husband of informant and others under Sections 147, 148, 149, 302, 307 and 506 I.P.C. at Case Crime No. 478 of 2021 at P.S. Shahganj, District- Agra and only due to this reason under retaliation with malicious intention,
informant
lodged first information report of the present case against applicant on 15.12.2022 on the basis of totally false and frivolous allegations.

He further submitted that applicant although made accused earlier in three other cases but after lodgement of the present first information report, he was made accused in seven other cases but he has explained the criminal history of applicant in paragraph no. 11 onwards to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.
He next submitted that in the present matter applicant is in jail since 21.08.2022.

Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for informant opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that earlier applicant has lodged a first information report against husband of the informant with regard to murder of his father and during investigation no enquiry was made by Investigating Officer from the U.P. Board with regard to alleged fake educational documents of applicant and applicant in the present matter is in jail since 21.08.2022.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
It appears that due to the reason that husband of informant was made accused by the applicant in murder case of his father, the first information report of the present case was lodged by informant on the basis of general and omnibus allegations with regard to fake educational documents of applicants but during investigation, Investigating Officer did not collect any evidence from the U.P.
Board with regard to educational certificates of applicant of the years 2006 and 2008.
Although applicant is having criminal history of ten other cases but his criminal history has been explained in affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.
Applicant is in jail in the present matter since 21.08.2022.
Therefore, in view of the discussion made above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

In the light of discussions made above, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant - Mahan Mudgal be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
